summary_en: A quiet Sunday. Vitalik posted a long personal view on where the Ethereum Foundation is going, stressing that the board is not just him and that aerugoettinea is executing much of the transition. Eli Ben-Sasson compared the privacy trade-offs of Zcash and Starknet. donnoh_eth wished there were an L2BEAT for privacy; two days later L2BEAT launched its privacy page.
